title: GET /ai/schema/{cubeId}/pii-suggestions is admin-only: a non-admin caller is refused before the schema cache is warmed or the PII scanner findings are read

criteria.given: AiQueryResource.getPiiSuggestions is called by a caller without ROLE_ADMIN
criteria.then: it carries @RolesAllowed("ROLE_ADMIN") and refuses with 403 before it calls getSchema or getPiiSuggestions
